calibration_admission: Heldout grid fitted-law mean decision regret <=0.001 per decision and max Q error <=0.004 on IID and OOD, STOP exactly0, native/reference parity <=1e-7. Neural residual bound does not establish unstructured neural-DP learning.
cell_training: Four next-observation updates plus twelve task-residual updates through complete causal recurrence. No L2 term in reported task gradients.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation squared residual error, with action regret reported; same initialization, minibatches, budget and 1743 allocated parameters. STOP head is structurally inactive for both.
failure_policy: Preserve failures, freeze code/models before heldout generation, do not tune to heldout; a negative net result is a failed scientific claim, not a reason to omit the arm.
grid_selection: First validation grid with max feasible-Q error <=0.002 and mean fitted-law action regret <=0.0001. Selection precedes all heldout generation.
net_admission: Positive simultaneous lower confidence bound for analytic minus ordinary on IID and OOD, changed real actions under constant-state intervention, and positive lower bound including measured training/shared setup/native process CPU at price0.01 amortized over1000. No energy-equivalent claim without measurement.
reference: Independent exact finite posterior-tree Bellman recursion with the identical TRAIN-fitted observation law; unavailable evaluator labels never enter a controller.
scope: Fresh synthetic two-job native control; ordinary fitted belief-grid Bellman value plus capacity-matched trained bounded residuals. Content and full-HX numerical protocols are separately scoped.
uncertainty: Two-sided paired Student-t intervals over five independent fits, Bonferroni three contrasts separately on IID/OOD; episodes are not independent model fits.
